ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Federal Funding Freezes on Small Businesses
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of federal funding freezes on small businesses, including the recent freeze in Western Pennsylvania.
questions: What is the impact of federal funding freezes on small businesses?
Are there any connections to other federal programs or agencies?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a larger issue with the federal budget and its impact on small businesses. By analyzing data and conducting interviews, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can inform policy decisions.
